items.title_zh: API Evangelist 发布的 BrainCo 公共 API 档案
items.title_en: BrainCo Public API Profile by API Evangelist
bullets_zh: API Evangelist 在 GitHub 发布了独立第三方档案，记录 BrainCo 的公开 API 接口。
该档案将 BrainCo 描述为由哈佛创新实验室创立、开发非侵入式脑机接口硬件与开发者 SDK 的公司。
档案涵盖消费级/科研头环 API，帮助开发者评估非侵入式脑机接口的集成选项。
bullets_en: API Evangelist published an independent third-party GitHub profile documenting BrainCo’s public API surface.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
The profile covers consumer/research headset APIs, helping developers assess integration options for non-invasive BCI.
items.brief: 第三方整理的 BrainCo 非侵入式脑机接口公开 API 档案，便于开发者了解硬件与 SDK。
items.brief_en: Third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo’s public API for non-invasive BCI hardware and SDKs, useful for developers.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

bullets_zh: GitHub项目NIA-Project提出面向自适应非侵入式脑机接口人机交互的集成数字环境。
发布于2026-09-18，与非侵入式脑机接口的开源软件栈相关。
它可作为自适应、非手术BCI交互平台的潜在参考实现。
bullets_en: GitHub project NIA-Project presents an integrated digital environment for human-digital interaction in adaptive non-invasive BCI.
Published on 2026-09-18, it is relevant to open-source software stacks for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
It matters as a potential reference implementation for adaptive, non-surgical BCI interaction platforms.

bullets_en: AxonOS community radar is a GitHub project maintaining an auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
Published on 2026-09-19, it can help researchers and developers discover tools, datasets, and projects in non-invasive BCI ecosystems.
It matters as a community directory rather than a single algorithm or device.

items.title_en: eeg-bci-unity-control: Real-time Unity Game Control from EEG
bullets_zh: eeg-bci-unity-control是GitHub项目，实现基于EEG信号的Unity游戏实时控制。
发布于2026-09-18，结合信号处理、CSP/LDA分类和LSL通信用于非侵入式BCI演示。
它作为消费者/研究者EEG到游戏管线的实用集成示例有价值。
bullets_en: eeg-bci-unity-control is a GitHub project implementing real-time Unity game control from EEG signals.
Published on 2026-09-18, it combines signal processing, CSP/LDA classification, and LSL communication for non-invasive BCI demos.
It matters as a practical integration example for consumer/researcher EEG-to-game pipelines.
items.brief: 开源示例，用EEG信号实时控制Unity游戏。
items.brief_en: Open-source example using EEG signals to control Unity games in real time.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control using signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.

items.title_en: EEG_Deformer: PyTorch Dense Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
bullets_zh: EEG_Deformer是GitHub上的PyTorch实现，使用密集卷积Transformer解码BCI应用中的EEG信号。
发布于2026-09-19，面向非侵入式EEG分类，可用于模型基准测试或原型开发。
它作为基于EEG的BCI研究开源深度学习基线有价值。
bullets_en: EEG_Deformer is a GitHub PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for decoding EEG signals in BCI applications.
Published on 2026-09-19, it targets non-invasive EEG classification and could be useful for model benchmarking or prototyping.
It matters as an open-source deep-learning baseline for EEG-based BCI research.
items.brief: 基于PyTorch的EEG解码项目，服务非侵入式脑机接口分类。
items.brief_en: PyTorch EEG decoder project for non-invasive BCI signal classification.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for brain-computer interface applications.

It uses MOABB BCI benchmarks and adds extra paradigms for evaluation.

bullets_en: GitHub project updated on 2026-09-19 builds an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem.
It covers 8-64 channel hardware, MCU/FPGA targets, RTL, and PC/mobile/Linux integration.
It includes Python/MATLAB/R analysis and BCI workflows for non-invasive research.
